test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

His father prevented him to go abroad for higher studies.
solution: The erroneous part is **'to go abroad'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'from going abroad'** should be used instead of** 'to go abroad'.** • We know that '**prevent**' is followed by '**from**' not '**to**'. • After the **preposition,** the **gerund form **of the **verb** is used. • *Example: I have been unavoidably **prevented from coming.*** • Thus, the correct answer is **'to go abroad'.** **Correct Sentence:__** *His father prevented him **from going abroad** for higher studies.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां '**to go abroad**' के स्थान पर '**from going abroad**' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि '**prevent**' के बाद '**to**' नहीं '**from**' आता है। • **Preposition** के बाद **verb** के gerund form का प्रयोग किया जाता है। • *Example: I have been unavoidably **prevented from **coming.* • इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर** 'to go abroad' **है। d8:Tfb5, The correct answer is **'than most other'.**
